fusions.name: Scent Trail
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. A strike that deals 9 damage, leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds, and you heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Run Down
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 30% health. A strike that deals 24 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds after.

fusions.name: Stalking Veil
fusions.desc: Veils you for 8 seconds and restores 10 health. Enemies notice you far later, you move 15% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Quarry's Due
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you regain 3 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
